name: kq-person-read-cars
description: Call tool 'ciq_execute' with arguments: id: "<this query's id>", input_params: {person_external_id: (required) external_id of the Person whose cars to read, must match Bearer token 'sub'}. Auth: Bearer token required (Person subject), token subject = person_external_id. Returns: the Person node, the Car nodes they OWN, and the OWNS relationship.
